answer.reason: The verses show Darius ordering a search of the records and issuing a decree protecting the work on the house of God.

clauses.english: ordered a search of the royal records at Babylon for the decree about the house of God
clauses.quote: Darius the king made a decree, and search was made

clauses.english: decreed that whoever altered his word be hanged and his house made a dunghill
clauses.quote: I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word

doubts: HAG 1:1, HAG 1:15, HAG 2:10, ZEC 1:1, ZEC 1:7 and ZEC 7:1 only date the prophets' words by Darius's years, so no clause rests on them.
EZR 4:5, EZR 4:24 and EZR 6:15 only give the timing of events under his reign; they were not used as deeds of his.
Some verses in the middle of the Ezra 6 decree (EZR 6:4-9) were not given, so the clauses rest only on EZR 6:1 and 6:11-12.
